blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Veteran journalist Philip Lustre Jr. has asked the Supreme Court (SC) to transfer to Quezon City the cyberlibel complaint filed against him by lawyer Manases Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte. Lustre, 72, said his lawyers filed a motion before the SC on Friday, seeking to move the proceedings from Davao City, where the complaint was filed, to Quezon City, where he resides. The transfer of venue is being sought “to avoid a miscarriage of justice and to safeguard his constitutional right to life, security, personal safety, and a fair and impartial trial.” Lustre’s lawyers also mentioned […]...
